item.title: Version 0.1.25
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.25

  • Tabs are as wide as their titles: short ones show in full, long ones fade out at the end. When the bar is full it scrolls sideways, keeping the open tab in sight
  • One block handle at a time: the block under the pointer, else the one selected or being edited
  • iPhone: Papers and collections fit the screen; their controls go on a row of their own
  • iPhone and iPad: Select in All Pages, folders and Papers picks several pages or papers by tap, and a block's menu selects blocks and stretches the selection, to move or delete several at once
  • iPad with a keyboard or trackpad: ⌘-click and ⇧-click pick pages and papers, ⌘A selects them all, and a trackpad drag on empty space draws a selection rectangle. Selected blocks take the arrow keys, Tab, Delete, ⌘C, ⌘X and ⌘D as on the Mac, ⌘Z undoes when no text is being edited, and ⌘-click opens a link in a new tab

item.title: Version 0.1.24
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.24

  • Inbox: every space has an Inbox folder, and a page made outside a folder goes there. It can't be renamed or deleted; its menu sends all its pages to the Trash
  • Trash: right-click it to Restore All or Empty Trash
  • Papers has a screen of its own: cards with each PDF's first page, a list or a table, filters by reading status, search and sort, and PDFs dropped on it become papers. Papers can't be deleted; Settings › Papers turns it off, hiding every Add to Papers too
  • A paper's authors are links to their other papers
  • Fixed: a paper titled like a starter page ("Attention Is All You Need") could be deleted after a sync. Adding it again fills its old row
  • Add to Papers on a PDF in the sidebar keeps the PDF where it is
  • Collections on All Pages: New Collection makes an empty one with a screen of its own. Drag the tiles to reorder them, or remove one from the section
  • Collections: rename, recolour or delete a select's options, move columns and rows, show only rows with an option, and add a sum or average under a number column. Undoing a deleted row brings its page back too
  • Page icons can be SF Symbols
  • Page cards show the folder a page is in
  • On the Mac, drag on empty space to select several pages or papers at once, or press ⌘A
  • Fixed: a sidebar row could stay highlighted after you clicked elsewhere

item.title: Version 0.1.23
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.23

  • Locked pages and folders: lock a page, or a folder with everything in it, from its menu. One unlock with Touch ID, Face ID or your password opens them all until OnePaper goes to the background or the screen locks. While locked, a page shows only its title: no preview, no text in search, no to-dos in Tasks, and the assistant and agents leave it out
  • Undo and Redo now work for every kind of edit in a page: formatting, Turn Into, to-dos, dates, tables, collections, callouts, images, links, the page's icon, cover, colour and font, and assistant rewrites. A change made elsewhere (sync, an agent, a hub) is a step of its own
  • Tables turn into collections, with each column's type read from its cells, and a log of dates and numbers opens on its chart. Charts can show a target line or a shaded range
  • Sync status: a line at the foot of the sidebar says where iCloud sync stands, and what to do if it's stuck
  • HTML files import with their design: diagrams, callouts, toggles and columns come through. Table cells show bold, code and links styled
  • Big libraries stay fast: All Pages, Tasks and the journal show cards as you scroll, typing in long pages does less work, and the search panel loads only when opened
  • Several windows: a page open in two windows edits cleanly, with one Undo history, and each save does much less work per window
  • Pages with many tables or SVGs open faster. Turn into › SVG shows an SVG written as text as a picture
  • iPhone and iPad: block handles show again; on iPad with a pointer, the margin beside a block shows its handle

item.title: Version 0.1.22
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.22

  • Papers: right-click a PDF and choose Add to Papers to file it in your Papers library, with its title, authors, year, venue and link looked up. A PDF inside a page can be added too, and it stays where it is. Each paper gets its own page with Read, Summarize this paper and Add highlights
  • Summarize this paper: a summary, the key formulas and the main figures, each linked to its page in the PDF
  • People: the authors of your papers get a People collection, and each person's page lists their papers
  • PDFs you drop in stay PDFs, shown with a PDF mark and a first-page preview
  • Collections: a chart view, a row's page shows its properties under its title, and rows follow their pages (a paper moved to the Trash leaves the table, and comes back if restored)
  • All Pages has a Collections section at the top that stays put while you edit other pages. Settings › General › Collections turns the feature off
  • Trackers: log an entry from the menu bar or with Shortcuts
  • Blocks side by side: drag a block onto the right edge of another to put it in a new column, or use Put Beside Block Above
  • SVG shows as drawn, whether written in Markdown, pasted or drawn by the assistant. Double-click it to edit its source, or convert it to a whiteboard from its menu
  • Math: numbered equations, references to them with a preview on hover, and Copy Formula as LaTeX or as an image. More LaTeX renders, including amsmath environments
  • A tag's page is the topic's hub: its papers, people, books, concepts and open to-dos together
  • Copy pages in one copy of OnePaper and paste them in another, with their images and files
  • Bold, italic and the like now show around links and code (**[[Page]]**)
  • Fixed: a page open in a tab could undo a change made to it elsewhere, such as a paper added to Papers
  • Fixed: a starred page no longer shows as selected twice in the sidebar
  • Journal: select several entries to delete them together. Daily notes two devices made for the same day are merged
  • MCP: agents can add papers, attach files, create folders, rename, move and delete pages, create several pages at once, filter by tag and search with matching lines

item.title: Version 0.1.21
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.21

  • Nest a block by dragging it to the right as you move it: each step right puts it one level deeper under the block above. A block dragged over its own spot can be nested or un-nested where it is
  • Indent and Outdent in a single block's right-click menu
  • While you drag a block, the page scrolls when you hold it near the top or bottom edge, or past the window
  • Excalidraw files dropped on or attached to a page become whiteboards you can draw on in place. An Excalidraw file attached before can be shown as a whiteboard from its block menu (Show as › Whiteboard)
  • MCP: agents can edit a page in place (edit_page), and draw Excalidraw diagrams as whiteboards, in a page or on their own (create_whiteboard, update_whiteboard)
  • Mac: Print and Save as PDF work again, and File › Print… prints the page in front

item.title: Version 0.1.20
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.20

  • Hide completed to-dos on a page: click the to-do count under the title, or choose Hide Completed To-dos in the page's menu. The setting syncs with the page
  • Page cards in All Pages show the word count, to-dos done and when the page was last edited (Settings › Appearance › Show details on page cards turns this off)
  • Images copied as Markdown and pasted back show as images waiting for their picture, instead of `![image]()`
  • The Assistant button fades out while you type, so it no longer covers the text
  • Typing on long pages is lighter: the page's Markdown is no longer rebuilt on every keystroke
  • Mac: the sidebar no longer stalls half way as it slides in on narrow windows, and long pages stay smooth while it slides
  • Mac: no line under the title bar in a page's own window

item.title: Version 0.1.19
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.19

  • Videos play in the page: a MOV, MP4 or M4V attached to a page shows as a player (right-click › Show as › Attachment turns it back into a card)
  • Mac: the sidebar slides in and out smoothly, with the tabs following it instead of stepping the wrong way first
  • Mac: leaving focus mode no longer reshuffles the tabs while the sidebar comes back
  • Mac: with the top bar on Auto Hide, clicking the sidebar button no longer hides and shows the bar

item.title: Version 0.1.18
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.18

  • iPhone: tapping a PDF in the reader no longer closes the app
  • iPad: deleting a drawing on a PDF clears it from the page at once
  • The PDF reader keeps its zoom and place when the Draw tool goes on or off
  • Mac: clicking the top bar of a window in the background brings it forward and makes it active

item.title: Version 0.1.17
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.17

  • Format selected text: on the Mac a bar above the selection has bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, code and text colours (strong and light); on iPhone and iPad they're in a Format menu in the selection menu and the keyboard bar. Choose a style again to take it off. ⌘U underlines
  • Paste a link to an arXiv paper and choose Paper PDF: the PDF is downloaded and put on the page, with the paper's details filled in. An arXiv bookmark or link has it under Show as
  • The slash menu and other inline menus open upwards near the bottom of the window instead of being cut off
  • iPhone and iPad: Undo and Redo buttons in the page's top bar and above the keyboard, through the page's whole history while it's open
  • Return, Backspace at the start of a block and Delete at its end are steps of their own in Undo
  • iPhone and iPad: tap a PDF on a page to open it in the reader (a double tap still zooms)
  • iPhone: the book button opens a PDF in the reader after the page was opened from the library
  • iPad: a new drawing on a PDF no longer disappears a moment after it's drawn or when a note is picked
  • iPhone and iPad: a to-do's text uses the whole line while it's being edited, instead of wrapping half way across

item.title: Version 0.1.15
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.15

  • PDF reader: double-click a PDF on a page (or choose Open in Reader) to read it in a tab of its own, with page thumbnails, its table of contents, Find, zoom, and the page you left off on
  • Highlight, underline and comment on text in PDFs, mark a figure, table or equation with a box, or pin a note anywhere on a page; the Notes pane lists them all by page and colour
  • PDFs take your page theme's paper and text colours (or keep their own), light or dark, and show links as blue text instead of boxes
  • Copy Link to any highlight and paste it in a page: it opens the reader right there. A link can also show as an excerpt card with the highlighted spot cropped from the PDF, live
  • Add Highlights to Page puts a PDF's highlights and notes under it as quotes, each linked back to its spot; Copy Highlights as Markdown copies them
  • Paper details: a PDF's title, authors and year are read from it and filled in from arXiv or Crossref; copy BibTeX or a citation from the reader's ⓘ
  • Ask Claude about a paper, or select a passage and ask about that; add an answer to the page
  • Share or export a PDF with its highlights and notes written in, for Preview, Acrobat or Zotero
  • iPad: draw on PDFs with Apple Pencil
  • Find in All Pages searches the text of PDFs and their highlights and notes
  • Mac: Undo keeps a page's whole history (typing and block changes) while it's open, even after switching tabs
  • Mac: files and images dropped on a line of text go in as blocks
  • New Page and All Pages: pages are called pages everywhere
  • Settings › Papers has the reader's preferences

item.title: Version 0.1.14
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.14

  • Find in Page (⌘F) highlights every match on the page; ⌘G / ⇧⌘G or Return / ⇧Return step through them
  • Find in All Pages (⇧⌘F) opens a panel on the right listing every page with the text and the lines it's on; click a result to open it there
  • Search reads the text in images and whiteboards (on device)
  • Page History (⋯ menu): earlier versions of a page, each shown as it was, and Restore (which can be undone). Versions are kept on each device as you edit
  • Quick Capture: ⌃⌥⌘N from any app on Mac opens a small capture window; the share sheet on iPhone, iPad and Mac sends text, links and images to OnePaper; Shortcuts can capture a note or to-dos and create pages. Captures go to the Inbox, today's note or a new page
  • Files: attach PDFs and any other file to a page with /File or by dropping them in. PDFs and web pages show inline in a frame you can resize; other files show as a card with Quick Look, Open and Share
  • HTML files become pages when dropped on a folder or imported (Import Markdown or HTML…); Markdown files dropped into a page become a page under it, shown as a preview card
  • Block links: Copy Link to Block (block menu) links to one block; following it scrolls to the block. A block link on its own line can show as a mirror: the block, live, in another page
  • Page and whiteboard links can show as cards: the whole page, live and scrollable, or a whiteboard you draw on in place, each resizable by its bottom edge
  • Select several blocks at once on Mac: Esc then ⇧↑/⇧↓, ⇧-click, or drag down the margin; then move, indent, turn into, copy, cut, duplicate or delete them together
  • Renaming a page updates [[links]] to it in other pages; deleting a page other pages link to asks first. Links stay with their page when two pages share a title
  • Library: Rename… in a page's or whiteboard's right-click menu
  • A block moves with the blocks indented under it (and a heading with its section)
  • Mac tabs: ⌘-click a link to open it in a new tab; a page already open in a tab comes forward instead of opening twice; pages keep their scroll position when you return to their tab; links, cards and backlinks open the page instead of going Home; no more doubled tab bar
  • Focus mode hides the top bar too; ⌘S shows or hides the sidebar and ⇧⌘S toggles focus mode
  • Spelling: Add to Dictionary on a misspelled word, and turning off underlines clears them
  • iPhone and iPad: tap an image for its resize handles and alignment; Tasks no longer cuts off its scopes and totals
  • Images and files you delete from pages are cleared from iCloud after 30 days unused
  • Fixed a crash at launch in the gallery layout

item.title: Version 0.1.13
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.13

  • Settings are organised into panes: Appearance, Editor, AI, Tasks, Sync & Backup, Shortcuts and About
  • About shows the version and lets you check for updates and choose whether updates download and install automatically
  • Editor on Mac: one drag handle (≡) in the left gutter, as in Notion and Craft — drag to move a block, click to select it, right-click for its menu; it also appears when the pointer is in the margin beside a block
  • Blocks can be dropped anywhere on the page, margins included, with a single line showing where they'll land
  • Right-click a selected block for the block menu
  • Markdown files dropped on a sidebar folder now become pages (they also can be dropped on a folder's page, All Docs or Starred); dropping a Finder folder imports the Markdown files inside; ⌘Z undoes an import
  • Image captions stay centred under the image when it's aligned left or right

item.title: Version 0.1.12
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.12

  • AI agents on your Mac (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor…) can create, read and add to pages: turn it on in Settings › AI Agents (MCP) and copy the setup command
  • Assistant: attach files (paperclip, or drop them on it) — text, Markdown, PDF, Word, RTF, HTML and images — and ask for a summary to insert into the page
  • Editor on Mac: a selected block shows quick actions beside it (move, duplicate, copy, more, delete); ⌘C copies it
  • Typed arrows and symbols: -> becomes →, != becomes ≠, <= becomes ≤ and more (can be turned off in Settings › Editor)
  • ⌘Z on a new, untouched page undoes creating it
  • Sidebar: drop Markdown files from Finder on a folder (or the Folders header) to import them as pages
  • Sidebar: drop pages and folders on the Folders header to move them to the top level
  • Sidebar: ⌘-click and ⇧-click pick only what you click, and Delete removes them even if you were typing in a page
  • Sidebar hover highlights and previews stay quiet while a menu or sheet is open
  • Opening the assistant in one window no longer opens it in every window
  • Smoother sidebar toggle button when showing or hiding the sidebar

item.title: Version 0.1.11
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.11

  • Backups: OnePaper keeps daily copies of your library (in a folder you can choose) and can restore everything missing, or just the pages you pick
  • Pages: Copy a page in the sidebar or library, then Paste it on a folder to make a copy there; ⌘C and ⌘V work in the sidebar too
  • Sidebar on Mac: ↑/↓ preview pages without opening them, Return opens; hover previews can be turned off in Settings
  • Sidebar: ⌘-click and ⇧-click pick a row wherever you click on it; no more bounce when everything fits
  • Editor on Mac: click in the margin beside a block to select it, and Delete removes blocks one by one, upwards; a faint hint shows which block a click would select (can be turned off in Settings)
  • Delete on a line below an image, card or table selects that block, ready to delete
  • Bookmarks show the real title, description and thumbnail (including YouTube, Vimeo and Loom), with the thumbnail beside the details
  • Link menus (Paste as bookmark or embed) can be clicked with the mouse, and Undo removes a pasted link
  • Fixed a crash on Undo or Redo after editing a block that had since been removed

item.title: Version 0.1.10
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.10

  • Sidebar on Mac: ⌘-click or ⇧-click to pick several pages and folders, then drag them onto a folder, or right-click to star, move, export or delete them together
  • Folders can be dragged into other folders
  • Sidebar hover highlight now matches the selection, including nested pages and folders
  • Right-clicking a folder, page or tag in the sidebar no longer outlines it in blue
  • Assistant: Shift-Return adds a new line; text is sharper on non-Retina displays
  • Images: ⌘V on a selected image pastes below it

item.title: Version 0.1.9
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.9

  • Multiple windows: File › New Window (⌃⌘N) opens a window with its own tabs and history; iPad can open more than one window too
  • Press ⌘A twice to select the whole page, then copy, cut or delete it
  • ⌘Z now undoes block changes too, such as a pasted, cut or deleted image
  • Images: copy and cut them with ⌘C / ⌘X or from the block menu
  • AI on Mac: use Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI or OpenCode with your own plan, now also in the downloaded app (Settings › AI, one-time set-up)
  • Tabs in the sidebar: only the open tab is highlighted, text stays crisp, right-click no longer outlines the row in blue, and moving tabs back to the top leaves the sidebar tidy
  • iPhone: all accent colours show in Settings instead of being cut off

item.title: Version 0.1.8
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.8

  • Images: click one to select it, then press Delete to remove it
  • iPad: a selected folder in the sidebar is highlighted, instead of only its text turning white
  • Mac: the app opens without the "Apple could not verify OnePaper" warning when installed with Homebrew

item.title: Version 0.1.7
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.7

  • Fixes a crash that could happen when moving between pages and sections, such as opening Calendar after switching pages
  • iPad: switching pages from the sidebar no longer leaves a blank page without its toolbar
  • iPad: pages behave like on Mac. The sidebar highlights the open page, and Back appears only after you follow a link
  • Quick Open and the command palette take the keyboard when they open, so typing goes into them rather than the page
  • Mac: Esc closes Quick Open and the command palette, and pressing their shortcut again closes them

item.title: Version 0.1.6
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.6

  • Focus mode: just the page, without the sidebar and the top bar. Toggle it with ⇧⌘F or from Quick Open
  • Quick Open runs commands too: type "focus", "theme" or "sidebar" to toggle them, or start with > (⇧⌘P on Mac) to list only commands
  • Removes the duplicate starter pages and folders ("Welcome to OnePaper", "Machine Learning", "Engineering"…) that appeared once iCloud sync started working, for libraries set up with 0.1.0–0.1.2. Pages you added to those folders move to the remaining one
  • Fixes a crash on launch while the duplicates were being removed
  • Mac: switching tabs no longer flickers. The tab pill slides as one piece, the close button stays put, and the tab bar doesn't jolt
  • Mac: the sidebar changes colour together with the title bar
  • Mac: the search button sits at the right edge of the window
  • iPhone: pages in the sidebar open again (they showed the last folder instead), and Back returns to the sidebar
  • iPhone and iPad: folder Edit and New Folder open as a sheet instead of off the edge of the screen
  • iPhone and iPad: the / menu opens above lines low on the screen, clear of the keyboard
  • iPhone: page titles show in list rows, the page details fit the width, and the whiteboard title fits beside its buttons
  • iPhone: the keyboard toolbar's overflow menu shows each item's name, and the cursor stays above the toolbar as you type

item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.5

  • Folders can nest: make a folder inside another from its menu, or move one with Move to…. Subfolders show in the sidebar and at the top of their parent folder
  • New page and folder menus, like Craft's: open in a new tab or window, copy a link, copy or export as Markdown, plain text or HTML, move, duplicate and more
  • Select several pages in the library with ⌘-click or ⇧-click, then star, move or delete them together. A plain click opens a page
  • Paste an image straight into a page from the clipboard
  • Resize images with the handles on either side, and align them left, centre or right
  • Clicking outside a block, or into another one, clears the text selection
  • To-dos no longer re-wrap when you hover them; the date button sits right after the text
  • Quick Open (⌘K) opens in the middle of the window
  • With the sidebar hidden, the sidebar button no longer overlaps the tab bar
  • Pages fade in when you switch to them, including from the sidebar

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.4

  • Tasks › Inbox: capture to-dos quickly and sort them out later. Inbox tasks stay undated unless you type a date ("book flights friday"), and the Inbox menu clears completed ones
  • Mac: dragging a window's top corners or edges now resizes it instead of moving it
  • A cleaner About window, with the app's tagline, a link to its page and a copyright line

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.3

  • iCloud sync: pages from your Mac and iPhone now show up together. Each device used to create its own "Personal" space, so synced pages ended up in a space you couldn't see; those spaces are now merged into one automatically
  • Starter pages no longer appear twice when you set up another device

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.2

  • Tabs: open pages side by side, with a New Tab page for creating pages and reopening recent ones
  • Show tabs at the top of the window, auto-hidden, or in the sidebar (right-click the tab bar)
  • Craft-style window: the sidebar and toolbar take on the open page's colour, and pages fill the window (turn on Backdrop in Page Style for a floating sheet)
  • Option to use the same theme for every page
  • Paste a link as plain text, a bookmark card, or an embed: YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, Spotify and Figma play right in the page (also `/embed`)
  • New assistant panel with preset prompts, saved prompts and conversation history
  • Sidebar: the space switcher sits at the top, folders expand to show their pages, pin your key tags, All Tags view, quick task and new folder buttons
  • Folder icons: a searchable grid of about 200 icons with colour swatches
  • Inline `$…$` math is drawn as formulas in the editor and in page previews
  • Dark page colours (Midnight, Terminal, Graphite…) now switch the sidebar to light text, and the Page Style panel stays open while you change colours
  • Whiteboards open without a zoom jump, and the starred page you're on is highlighted in the sidebar
  • Grid layout keeps cards inside their cells

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
OnePaper 0.1.1

  • Fixes the Mac app crashing at launch in 0.1.0
  • New app icon
  • ⌘W closes the open page instead of the window
  • New pages closed without a title or content are discarded instead of saved as "Untitled"
  • Back and Forward (⌘[ / ⌘]) are in the Go menu
  • New Doc and New Whiteboard respond anywhere along their sidebar row
  • Sidebar navigation works again from every screen, including whiteboards, and responds to a normal tap on iPhone
  • Whiteboard previews in the library show the drawing instead of "Empty whiteboard"
  • Whiteboards can be renamed from the toolbar or ⋯ › Rename…
  • Empty whiteboards no longer open zoomed in to 3000%
